LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Midwest_Novice_1: {PAWN} swept a stretch of prairie for salvage, keeping an eye out for anything worth flagging for the survey teams.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Midwest_Novice_2: {PAWN} logged a quiet patrol along the frontier - a few scavvers scattered at the sight of power armor, nothing worth a full report.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Midwest_Novice_3: {PAWN} picked through a collapsed grain silo, filling a pack with whatever hadn't rusted through.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Midwest_Novice_4: {PAWN} walked the perimeter, charted a few new landmarks, and came back with dust in every seam of the armor.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Midwest_Veteran_1: {PAWN} secured an old bunker on the frontier and left word for a garrison to follow.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Midwest_Veteran_2: {PAWN} talked down a band of settlers wary of the Brotherhood and came back with two new recruits in tow.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Midwest_Veteran_3: {PAWN} spent the trip mapping a stretch of unclaimed prairie, marking it for the next expansion push.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Midwest_Veteran_4: {PAWN} came back with a busted rifle sling and a raider banner as proof the outpost held.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Midwest_Elite_1: {PAWN} pushed into unclaimed territory alone and came back with a full survey ready for the next garrison.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Midwest_Elite_2: {PAWN} ran the operation exactly as planned - in, secure the ground, out before anything organized a response.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Midwest_Elite_3: {PAWN} spent the better part of two weeks past the frontier and returned with word of a settlement worth recruiting.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Midwest_Elite_4: {PAWN} didn't say much about what happened out there, just filed the survey and asked for new orders.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Midwest_Sentinel_1: {PAWN} pushed past the edge of any map the Vanguard has, charting ground for the next wave of settlers.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Midwest_Sentinel_2: {PAWN} came back from unclaimed territory with a full report and coordinates worth planting a flag over.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Midwest_Sentinel_3: {PAWN} spent nearly two weeks out of contact and returned with word of ground worth the General's attention.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Midwest_Sentinel_4: {PAWN} walked back into camp looking like the wasteland itself, carrying proof of what was found past the frontier.
